name: Calibrated Open-Ended Inquiries ("How / What")
scenario: Enterprise client insists on customized code escrow and exclusive IP ownership for standard multi-tenant software modules.
script: "How am I supposed to grant your organization exclusive intellectual property ownership over core multi-tenant architectural components without breaking our regulatory security commitments to every other enterprise tenant on the system?"
defense: Return the burden: the codebase separates core platform modules from tenant logic; we will show the schematic.
originFull: Cognitive Burden Shifting and System 2 Activation remove accusatory "Why" prompts in favor of functional interrogatives, forcing the counterparty to use executive processing resources to solve the negotiator's structural impediments.
defenseFull: When targeted with an inquiry designed to force an operational retreat, return the structural burden: "By segregating your codebase into core platform modules and proprietary tenant-specific logic. Our engineering team can provide the architectural schematic to show you how to execute it."
